_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_dynamics#7 — one slender inline HEX8 cantilever under GenAlpha, three densities. DENS 1.0 finalises all 12 steps and exits 0. DENS 0.0 finalises none and throws 'You are about to invert a singular matrix!' from structure_new/4C_structure_new_integrator.cpp — loud, immediate, and therefore the GOOD outcome. DENS -1.0 parses without complaint (MAT_Struct_StVenantKirchhoff has no validator on DENS), finalises 7 of the 12 steps on this deck and only then throws the generic 'The nonlinear solver did not converge!' from solver_nonlin_nox/4C_solver_nonlin_nox_problem.cpp, whose text names neither the density nor the material (DENS_NEG_DIAGNOSTIC_NAMES_DENSITY=0). The exact step count is left out of the assertions on purpose; DENS_NEG_DIED_AFTER_RUNNING=yes is the part that carries the claim. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: You are about to invert a singular matrix!
The nonlinear solver did not converge!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the negative arm: flip the sign back. It then runs to the end like the positive arm, EXIT_DENS_NEG becomes 0 and the NOX non-convergence message disappears, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the zero arm: give it a physical density. The singular-matrix throw and DENS_ZERO_STEPS=0 both go away, so the fixture must go red.
